summary.headline: Mars in the Water and Earth Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the appearance of Mars in Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, including effects on rain, crops, disease, war, rulers, prices, and regional conditions. Hermes’s prognostications also distinguish eastern evening appearances and planetary mixtures with Venus, the Moon, and Saturn.
